summary: Finished and verified the composer command-discovery feature: typing `/` opens an autocomplete menu with keyboard/mouse navigation, descriptions, and source labels; covered Pi extension commands, prompt templates, and skills via `/skill:name` syntax. Ran formatting, type checks, and 83 tests across app, agent-server, and protocol packages, plus a live smoke test that returned 13 commands, then committed docs, the feature, and a protocol version bump.
decisions: Bumped protocolVersion from 18 to 19 in packages/protocol/src/index.ts to introduce command discovery over the WebSocket transport.
Split documentation into apps/app/PRODUCT.md and apps/app/DESIGN.md (with apps/app/.impeccable/design.json) as a separate commit ahead of the feature commit.
Skills are inserted into the composer using Pi's `/skill:name` syntax rather than a separate UI affordance.
Treat CLI-only built-ins like /model, /settings, and /resume as out of scope for this round — they will need dedicated web actions later rather than being sent as prompts.
errors: Playwright screenshot script failed with `Cannot find module 'playwright'` (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) when invoked from a piped node stdin in the project root, so no screenshot was captured.
